room_checks.method: Source labels, declared room identifiers and producer room types checked against real PDF-derived plan maps; checks validate lookup/evidence, not upstream extraction accuracy.

needs_awais: No new hook required. Consumes existing label, props.number and props.room_type. Some producer regions combine multiple labels/numbers/areas: preserves those source items and does not split or validate their upstream quantities.
needs: Integrator merge; eight unrelated selected-suite failures reproduce on the starting filters (unit-baseline.json).
reproduction: MODELS_FAKE=1 scripts/heavy.sh .venv/bin/python -m engine.tests.validate_pdfspaces --pdf <PDF paths from development.json or blind.json> --output <room-checks.json>
